scope: Optional bounded historical per-container event index for only HolderMayPointInto second scan; no lifetime/provenance/root rule change intended. This focused qualification is not a general semantic proof or whole compiler/runtime qualification.

candidate.optional_mode: --holder-event-index requires --checker-trace; absent flag retains prior implementation. Index enabled in this explicit variant; trace/profile output disabled unless corresponding env nonempty.

mutation_inventory.nonmembership_mutation: typecheck_builtins.h direct classread update only; remains read live
mutation_inventory.absent_mutations: Full source inventory found no event-list clear/resize/erase/pop/swap/reset/assignment outside centralized replacement. This contract must be revisited if writers change.
mutation_inventory.historical_ids: IndexStoreEvent registers current container on append and replacement. Sorted unique absolute IDs retain old memberships; original current-container guard removes stale postings.
mutation_inventory.recursion: Reviewed query path HolderMayPointInto/StoredSlotMayPointInto and their type/lazy construction leaves does not enter event-mutating checker calls. Borrowed posting iterators cross read-only recursive queries only.

preserved: First loop and preconditions byte-identical (runner assertion)
Second loop from lower_bound preserves absolute ascending event order
Original current-container/source/classread/StoredLater checks and recursive slot predicates
Original found/where/hitat/via behavior, including diagnostic location and first hit
Classread normalization read live; no classification cached

bounds.map_overhead: Additional bounded holder-map/vector headers/buckets; payload bound is not total RSS.
bounds.fallback: On ID overflow, holder cap or retained-capacity exhaustion, permanently disable/free entire index and perform original raw second scan. No partial map may answer queries. Null container indexed too.

controls.actual_methods: Actual AST + source-extracted append/replace/index, both HolderMayPointInto overloads, StoredSlotMayPointInto. Type/depth/liveness query leaves controlled; no full TypeCheck fixture.
controls.laws: Recursive slot paths, class/copy/global/cycle cases, first-hit and all output locations, exact StoredLater call order, from bounds, historical retarget/order/duplicate IDs, null container, append between queries, global capacity/holder/ID-range fallback, deterministic mixed-graph matrix. Debug production helper recomputes raw membership/order.
controls.semantic_result: PASS vs baseline54f, including actual invalid lifetime/global/export/thread/function-value/signature checks and valid run/export/unused extern compile+link.
controls.trace_controls: Small emitted-C fixtures allocated postings but did not enter second-scan queries (queries=0); actual-method fixture exercises index hits/misses/fallback. Macro activity/capacity must be measured on real workload; no speedup claimed here.

macro_performance_claim: None; parent owns concurrent whole emission and executed engine-law batch.
